source.title: Brutus - Blood Claw
source.name: Brutus
source.description: A valiant warrior who is indomitable in the front line.

skills.name: Whirlwind Wrath

description.raw: Brutus spins Mountain's Roar at high speed and deals 110% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage every second to adjacent enemies within 1 tile for 4s. He is unaffected while spinning.
active: Brutus spins Mountain's Roar at high speed and deals 110% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage every second to adjacent enemies within 1 tile for 4s.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases damage to 120% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based)
Unlocks at level 111: Brutus is immune to control effects while spinning.
This skill's duration stacks with the duration of his other damage immunities.
Unlocks at level 171: Increases damage to 130% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based)
Unlocks at level 231: Increases damage to 140% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based)

skills.description_lite: Brutus spins his sword, dealing damage to adjacent enemies every second.

skills.name: Ferocious Roar

description.raw: Brutus roars with rage, taunting surrounding enemies within 2 tiles for 1.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s and reducing their Phys DEF by 15% for 9s.
active: Brutus roars with rage, taunting surrounding enemies within 2 tiles for 1.5 + 0.5 (SP-based)s and reducing their Phys DEF by 15% for 9s.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Reduces surrounding enemies' Phys DEF by 20%.
Unlocks at level 131: Reduces surrounding enemies' Phys DEF by 25%.
Unlocks at level 191: Reduces surrounding enemies' Phys DEF by 30%.

skills.description_lite: Brutus roars, taunting nearby enemies and reducing their Phys DEF.

skills.name: Indomitable

description.raw: Brutus is immune to the first fatal blow he receives. He is then immune to all damage and becomes unaffected for 5 + 1 (SP-based)s.
active: Brutus is immune to the first fatal blow he receives.
He is then immune to all damage and becomes unaffected for 5 + 1 (SP-based)s.

text: Unlocks at level 91: Immunity grants 25 Life Drain and 25% ATK.
Unlocks at level 151: Immunity grants 35 Life Drain and 30% ATK.
Unlocks at level 211: Immunity grants 35 Life Drain and 35% ATK.

skills.description_lite: Brutus is immune to the first fatal blow, and physical and magic damage for a short time.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Brutus increases his Life Drain by 10 during battle. He gains an extra 5 Life Drain during his Ultimate.
active: Brutus increases his Life Drain by 10 during battle.
He gains an extra 5 Life Drain during his Ultimate.

text: Brutus increases his Life Drain by 13 during battle.
He gains an extra 7 Life Drain during his Ultimate.
Brutus increases his Life Drain by 16 during battle.
He gains an extra 8 Life Drain during his Ultimate.

skills.description_lite: Brutus increases his Life Drain during battle, and it further increases when using Whirlwind Wrath.

skills.name: Cleaving Strike

description.raw: Brutus cleaves with all his might to enemies within 1-tile arc in front after receiving physical damage 10 times from adjacent enemies, dealing 200% (ATK-based) damage plus 12% of the target's max HP. The total damage cannot exceed 750% (ATK-based). Brutus also gains 30% Life Drain. This skill can be triggered once every 5s.
active: Brutus cleaves with all his might to enemies within 1-tile arc in front after receiving physical damage 10 times from adjacent enemies, dealing 200% (ATK-based) damage plus 12% of the target's max HP.
This skill can be triggered once every 5s.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 5: Brutus deals 230% (ATK-based) damage plus 12% of the target's max HP with this skill (the total damage cannot exceed 780% of his ATK).
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 10: Removes the cooldown limit for this skill.
Brutus can cast this skill for every 10 physical damage attacks he takes from adjacent enemies.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 15: Brutus deals 260% (ATK-based) damage plus 12% of the target's max HP with this skill (the total damage cannot exceed 780% of his ATK).

skills.description_lite: Brutus cleaves enemies in front and gains Life Drain after receiving physical damage several times from adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: The duration of damage immunity and unaffected status from Indomitable is increased by 1s.
active: The duration of damage immunity and unaffected status from Indomitable is increased by 1s.

skills.description_lite: Brutus increases the skill duration of Indomitable.
